title: Medical Records Privacy, Auditability, and Information Governance Policy
rules: All electronic patient record queries must record session_id, staff_id, and action in the audit_log.
Access to patient demographics and diagnostic records requires verified role-based access control (RBAC).
Physical or exported clinical summaries can only be released upon signed consent by the patient or registered next of kin.
Unidentified patient clinical data retained for research must be de-identified in compliance with DISHA guidelines.
exceptions: Statutory court summons and medico-legal requests signed by Chief Judicial Magistrate.
Public health contagious disease mandatory reporting to Department of Public Health.
